notes.title: v1.1.1 Now Live — IOOD OST Now Available!
notes.content:
[p]CalamityRhapsody has put together and released their complete Island Off Outer Darkness Original Soundtrack. If you've played some of the game then you already know how good it is. [b]Go support them on [/b][url="https://calamity-rhapsody.bandcamp.com/album/island-off-outer-darkness-ost"]Bandcamp[/url][b] and listen to it on YouTube! [/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://calamity-rhapsody.bandcamp.com/album/island-off-outer-darkness-ost"]Here's the Bandcamp link again.[/url] It's a name-your-price download, so go name your price and download it![/p][p][/p][p]Here's a YouTube embed for the full 2 hour 48 minute thing. It's so good.[/p][previewyoutube="NLch2v-NLG4;full"][/previewyoutube][p]If anybody's curious, my favorite track is It Settles, the song that plays during Week 4. I love them all though.[/p][p][/p][p]Alongside this, v1.1.1 of Island Off Outer Darkness is now live! Other than adding links to the OST to the Extras menu, this update is mostly bugfixes, though I did also do the fishing metagame calcs and added some of that info as a topic exclusive to repeat playthroughs.
[/p][p]Full patch notes:

menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed some ☇ response divergences.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed Razornuts' name color to be more purple.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the topic name that an NPC uses whenever you click on an "fot" on 7.1., making him completely uninteractable.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Bucephalus referring to Dire Apples with their full government name when talking about Argyrean Dire Apples.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Aleks' "mythed-about crop" instructions saying "white" instead of "black" (oops 😅 genuinely pretty major mistake there).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some of the guys in the boat on 2.1. not having suitable notes.title: v1.1.0 Now Available!
notes.content:
[p]It's out! Isn't that awesome. Addharthus has a new portrait, by the wonderful undead pvnk (who also made Homi's portrait, which has been in the game since the release version). So shoutouts to them! There's a new delivery after the intermission, as well as some minor changes to general dialogue throughout the game as well as bugfixes.

Full patch notes:[/p][list][*][p]Added a new portrait for Addharthus, by undead pvnk.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new delivery after the Bruegel Intermission that I forgot to include in the game but intended to by the end of development.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a few more topic responses for various characters.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a few more reactions to various weather events/aberrations.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new upgrade for repeat playthroughs that allows one to toggle on fixed RNG for fishing.[/p][list][*][p]Fixed RNG is seeded by the day, and can be activated daily. All fishing-related upgrades are disabled while active.[/p][/*][*][p]This is in order to make achievements that are related to fishing (or DP gain via fishing) "solved", if anyone wants to make a strategy guide.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added a notice of additional options for subsequent playthroughs upon beating the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an animation for the weather vane.[/p][list][*][p]It now moves![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added a few more devnotes.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed appearance of fishing cursor.[/p][list][*][p]This is to be more in line with other menus.[/p][/*][*][p]It has an alternate appearance when using fixed RNG.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed appearance of the Sand Poudrin.[/p][list][*][p]This is to be more in line with its canonical properties, as the lore on Argyrean sand was written after the fishing design was made.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed daily DP incentive post-wetter winter, removing some from the crow.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the cost of upgrades exclusive to repeat playthroughs — they are now free.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed a few bits of dialogue.[/p][list][*][p]These were generally responses that did not really take into account time progressing and Rekkieg changing.[/p][/*][*][p]The centre/center dichotomy has been normalized — Clavichord and the Postman's internal voice now uses exclusively "center", while every other character now uses exclusively "centre".[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed a few broken ☇ responses.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with very cheap upgrades visually showing more DP going into the purchase button than were actually spent.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with not being able to deliver Addharthus' and Brucehilda's deliveries to them on 4.1. without first delivering Eis'.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Debug Flag Accidentally Set in v.1.0.1, Now Fixed
notes.content: [p]A debug flag that caused the play to appear at the end of the game was accidentally set during testing for v.1.0.1 and was never reset. I am mortified by this, and I apologize intensely for this being the case. It is now fixed, and if you reset your save data, your save file should be fixed. I am so sorry.[/p]

notes.title: Incompatible with Steam Deck
notes.content:
[p]Island Off Outer Darkness is not compatible with Steam Deck at this time. To summarize, I designed the game for a 1440 x 1080 display and mouse and keyboard without much thought as to other displays or controller support, and it seriously limits what I can do now without an overhaul.

The current Steam Deck has a resolution of 1280 x 800, and Island Off Outer Darkness requires a 1440 x 1080 display at minimum, due to how the UI and camera systems are designed. These are pretty core to the game systems, and would require a significant overhaul to make function at smaller resolutions. Otherwise, the game's UI is not designed for controllers, as it mimics Morrowind's UI, and most menu handling is designed for either Mouse or (WASD + Arrow Keys + Spacebar + E).

In the future, I may implement support for a 1066 x 800 resolution mode for the Steam Deck, as well as optimize the menus for mixed inputs (controller for most things, using the capacitive touch screen as a simulated mouse for certain menus), but as of now neither of those things have been done and they are not actively planned.

Thank you for your interest in Island Off Outer Darkness. [/p]
